description:
# [1.6.0](https://github.com/dumb-software/T2C-App-Patch-Morphe/compare/v1.5.0...v1.6.0) (2026-08-18)


### Features

* **compatibility:** support T2C app v3.2.2 and update microservices endpoints ([ecd5219](https://github.com/dumb-software/T2C-App-Patch-Morphe/commit/ecd52195b0a9b5228968ccad29ecad768b348c34))

patches.name: Change API endpoint
patches.description: Points the app to a custom backend server by modifying environment variables.

options.description: Enter the base URL for the API (e.g., https://api.t2c.fr)

patches.name: Custom Umami endpoint
patches.description: Points the app to a custom Umami analytics server.

options.description: Enter the base URL for Umami (e.g., https://analytics.t2c.fr/api/send)

patches.name: Force environment
patches.description: Replaces the production environment variables with the developer or local ones.

patches.name: Remove Firebase tracking
patches.description: Removes Firebase App ID and Crashlytics API keys to disable Google tracking.

patches.name: Remove Google Maps API key
patches.description: Removes the Google Maps API key from the manifest to stop Google tracking.

patches.name: Remove Umami tracking
patches.description: Disables Umami tracking safely by modifying existing environment values.
